The high founded on the low (高以下為基), the noble on the humble (貴以賤為本), non-being the use of being (有以無為用), named as its 反 (此其反也): every clause is his, and “reversal” is the standard English for his 反 here. The reading leaves his comment on 弱者道之用 unused but claims nothing about it, so no drift. Plain sense: the key verse opens the chapter, the second unit is on all things springing from It as existing and non-existent, and the clause describes the verse (how the Tao moves and works) without a four-word run from it and without Legge’s parentheses. verse.js ok (Tao Te Ching 40, at [39]); entry-check ok.
